- # Advanced Metal Shader Optimization



The Metal shading language is an easy-to-use programming language for writing graphics and compute functions which execute on the GPU. Dive deeper into understanding the design patterns, memory access models, and detailed shader coding best practices which reduce bottlenecks and hide latency. Intended for experienced shader authors with a solid understanding of GPU architecture and hoping to extract every possible cycle.

2:48







[So you may have seen this pipeline if you watched any](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=168) [of the previous Metal talks.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=170) [And we will be focusing of course](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=172) [on the programmable stages of this pipeline,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=174) [as you can see there, the shader course.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=176)







2:59







[So first, Alex is going to go](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=179) [over some shader performance fundamentals](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=180) [and higher level issues.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=182) [After which, I'll return for some low-level,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=183) [down and dirty shader optimizations.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=186)







3:12







[Thanks, Fiona. Let me start by explaining the idea](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=198) [of shader performance fundamentals.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=199) [These are the things that you want to make sure](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=201) [that you have right before you start digging](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=202) [into source level optimizations.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=204) [Usually the impact of the kind](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=206) [of changes you'll make here can dwarf](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=207) [or potentially hide other more targeted changes](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=209) [that you make elsewhere.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=212) [So I'm going to talk about four of these today.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=213) [Address space selection for buffer arguments,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=214) [buffer preloading, dealing](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=217) [with fragment function resource writes,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=219) [and how to optimize your computer kernels.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=220) [So, let's start with addresses spaces.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=222)







3:46







[So since this functionality doesn't exist](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=226) [in all shading languages, I'll give a quick primer.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=228) [So, GPUs have multiple paths for getting date from memory.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=230) [And these paths are optimized for different use cases,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=233) [and they have different performance characteristics.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=237)







4:00







[In Metal, we expose control over which path is used](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=240) [to the developer by requiring that they qualify all buffers,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=243) [arguments and pointers in the shading language](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=247) [with which address space they want to use.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=249)







4:11







[So a couple of the address spaces specifically apply](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=251) [to getting information from memory.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=254) [The first of which is the device address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=257)







4:21







[This is an address space with relatively few restrictions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=261) [You can read and write data through this address space,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=263) [you can pass as much data as you want, and the buffer offsets](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=265) [that you specify at the API level have relatively flexible](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=268) [alignment requirements.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=270)







4:32







[On the other end of things, you have the constant address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=272) [As the name implies, this is a read only address space,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=276) [but there are a couple of additional restrictions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=278) [There are limits on how much data you can pass](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=280) [through this address space, and additionally the buffer offsets](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=282) [that you specify at the API level have more stringent](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=284) [alignment requirements.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=286)







4:48







[However, this is the address space that's optimized for cases](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=288) [with a lot of data reuse.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=291) [So you want to take advantage](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=292) [of this address space whenever it makes sense.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=293)







4:55







[Figuring out whether or not the constant address space makes](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=295) [sense for your buffer argument is typically a matter](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=298) [of asking yourself two questions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=300)







5:02







[The first question is, do I know how much data I have.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=302) [And if you have a potentially variable amount of data,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=305) [this is usually a sign that you need](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=307) [to be using the device address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=308)







5:11







[Additionally, you want to look at how much each item](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=311) [in your buffer is being read.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=315) [And if these items can potentially be read many times,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=316) [this is usually a sign that you want to put them](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=321) [into the constant address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=322)







5:24







[So let's put this into practice with a couple of examples](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=324) [from some vertex shaders.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=327)







5:29







[First, you have regular, old vertex data.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=329) [So as you can see, each vertex has its own piece of data.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=332) [And each vertex is the only one that reads that piece of data.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=336) [So there's essentially no reuse here.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=339) [This is the kind of thing that really needs to be](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=340) [in the device address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=342)







5:46







[Next, you have projection matrices, another matrices.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=346) [Now, typically what you have here is that you have one](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=351) [of these objects, and they're read by every single vertex.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=355)







6:00







[So with this kind of complete data reuse, you really want this](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=360) [to be in the constant address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=363) [Let's mix things up a little bit](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=364) [and take a look at standing matrices.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=369) [So hopefully in this case you have some maximum number](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=371) [of bones that you're handling.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=374)







6:16







[But if you look at each bone that matrix may be read](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=376) [by every vertex that references that bone,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=380) [and that also is a potential for a large amount of reuse.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=381) [And so this really ought to be](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=385) [on the constant address space as well.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=386) [Finally, let's look at per instance data.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=389)







6:31







[As you can see all vertices](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=391) [in the instance will read this particular piece of data,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=395) [but on the other hand you have a potentially variable number](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=398) [of instances, so this actually needs to be](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=400) [in the device address space as well.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=402)







6:45







[For an example of why address space selection matters](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=405) [for performance, let's move](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=408) [on to our next topic, buffer preloading.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=409)







6:52







[So Fiona will spend some time talking about how](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=412) [to actually optimize loads and stores within your shaders,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=415) [but for many cases the best thing that you can do is](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=417) [to actually off load this work to dedicated hardware.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=419) [So we can do this for you in two cases,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=422) [context buffers and vertex buffers.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=425)







7:07







[But this relies on knowing things about the access patterns](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=427) [in your shaders and what address space you've placed them into.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=431)







7:14







[So let's start with constant buffer preloading.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=434) [So the idea here is that rather than loading](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=437) [through the constant address space,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=440) [what we can actually do is take your data and put it](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=441) [into special constant registers that are even faster](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=443) [for the ALU to access.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=445)







7:27







[So we can do this as long](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=447) [as we know exactly what data will be read.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=448)







7:30







[If your offsets are known a compile time,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=450) [this is straightforward.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=452) [But if your offsets aren't known until run time then we need a little bit of extra information](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=454) [about how much data that you're reading.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=457)







7:39







[So indicating this](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=459) [to the compiler is usually a matter of two steps.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=462) [First, you need to make sure that this data is](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=465) [in the constant address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=466)







7:48







[And additionally you need to indicate](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=468) [that your accesses are statically bounded.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=470)







7:53







[The best way to do this is to pass your arguments](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=473) [by reference rather than pointer where possible.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=475) [If you're passing only a single item or a single struct,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=478) [this is straightforward, you can just change your pointers](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=480) [to references and change your accesses accordingly.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=482) [This is a little different if you're passing an array](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=485) [that you know is bounded.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=487)







8:09







[So what you do in this case is you can embed that size array](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=489) [and pass that struct by reference rather](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=492) [than passing the original pointer.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=494)







8:16







[So we can put this into practice with an example](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=496) [at a forward lighting fragment shader.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=499) [So as you can see in sort](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=501) [of the original version what we have are a bunch of arguments](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=503) [that are passed as regular device pointers.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=506) [And this doesn't expose the information that we want.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=507)







8:30







[So we can do better than this.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=510)







8:32







[Instead if we note the number](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=512) [of lights is bonded what we can do is we can put the light data](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=513) [and the count together into a single struct like this.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=516)







8:40







[And we can pass that struct in the constant address space](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=520) [as a reference like this.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=523)







8:44







[And so that gets us constant buffer preloading.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=524)







8:48







[Let's look at another example](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=528) [of how this can affect you in practice.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2016/606/?time=529)







8:52

```
Discover how you can improve Metal shader performance using some of the latest advancements in Apple GPUs. The intersection code is executed
```
in the original GPU function
and the hardware intersector needs to wait
until the code completes before continuing the traversal.
If you choose to use intersection query,
the hardware has no custom intersection functions to sort
and cannot group the execution.
It also needs to use more ray tracing scratch memory
to allow it to return to the GPU function.
Intersection query is the alternative model
for ray intersection to support portability
from other shading languages.
Since intersector aligns with the hardware implementation,
prefer intersector over intersection query.
If you do need to use intersection query,
use as few query objects as possible.
If multiple intersection queries are necessary,
try to reuse the query object, but change the properties.
This enables reuse of the ray tracing scratch for one query.
For example, if you have an intersection query object IQ1
for doing some ray tracing work,
and then if you need to do more ray tracing work
with the opaque opacity set,
then instead of creating new intersection query object,
simply use the intersection params
to reset the existing intersection query object
with opaque opacity.
This way you can reuse the ray tracing scratch memory.
When using multiple intersection queries,
avoid switching between them
and overlapping their traversal.
This avoids expensive swaps
between the in-progress hardware traversals.
For example, in your ray tracing work,
instead of switching from IQ1 to IQ2
and then back to IQ1.
Continue with IQ1 and complete the ray tracing work
with it before switching to IQ2.
To summarize ray tracing best practices,
use custom intersection function only when necessary.
Optimize ray payload.
Minimize the number of intersection tags.
Use intersector over intersection query.
To learn more about ray tracing with Metal,
please watch, "Your guide to Metal ray tracing."
And to learn how to use new ray tracing counters
from Metal debugger in Xcode,
check out, "Discover new Metal profiling tools for M3
and A17 Pro."
To recap, in order to improve performance
of your Metal shaders, you can reduce shader execution time
by using Metal features like function constants
and function groups.
Using such features can enable more optimization
opportunities in Metal, improve thread occupancy
with better resource utilization to increase parallelism.
Apply the best practices for intersection function,
ray payload, intersection tags,
and the intersector to make the best use
of the hardware accelerated ray tracing.
Thank you very much.

- # Learn performance best practices for Metal shaders



Discover how you can improve Metal shader performance using some of the latest advancements in Apple GPUs. Learn to reduce a shader's execution time by configuring function constants, and investigate ways to increase compiler optimization with function groups. Find out how to save run time by improving the shader's execution and ability to use resources in parallel. Explore the Apple family 9 GPU features and take advantage of hardware acceleration for ray tracing.

0:01







[Hello, my name is Srividya Karumuri](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1) [and I'm a GPU Compiler Engineer at Apple.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=3) [Today I'm here to share some tips](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=6) [that can improve the performance of your Metal shaders.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=8)







0:13







[The new Apple Family 9 GPU](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=13) [in M3 and A17 Pro have some new advancements](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=15) [that you could apply to your application.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=18) [I have some recommendations for Apple Family 9 GPUs.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=21) [In addition to guidance tips](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=25) [and tricks that apply to all Apple GPU generations.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=26)







0:31







[You can improve your shader's performance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=31) [by reducing their runtime](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=33) [with features in the Metal shading language,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=34) [increasing parallelism by improving resource utilization](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=38) [from the shader,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=41) [and making the most of the ray tracing acceleration](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=43) [hardware in the Apple Family 9 GPUs.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=45)







0:50







[Metal has several features](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=50) [that can minimize the shader's runtime including,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=51) [function constants, which can efficiently specialize](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=55) [a shader, function groups which can optimize shaders](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=57) [using indirect function calls.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=62)







1:05







[The Metal function constants](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=65) [features specializes the shader efficiently](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=66) [and removes the code that isn't reachable at runtime.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=69) [For example, uber shaders typically benefit](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=72) [from function constants.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=75)







1:18







[An uber shader is often complex](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=78) [because it can handle many different possibilities](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=81) [at runtime, such as rendering different material types](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=83) [in a 3D application.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=87)







1:29







[Developers sometimes make uber shaders](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=89) [that read material parameters from a buffer](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=92) [and then a material shader chooses different control parts](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=95) [at runtime based on the buffer's contents.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=98)







1:42







[This approach lets the shader render a new material effect](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=102) [without recompiling because the only changes](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=106) [are parameters in the buffer.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=109)







1:53







[For example, this uber shader in a pipeline](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=113) [renders a glossy material](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=117) [because a Metal buffer in the draw command](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=118) [has an is\_glossy parameter that's equal to true.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=121) [The same shader can also render a matte material](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=125) [when the buffer's is\_glossy parameter is equal to false.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=128)







2:13







[The render pipeline is the same for both material effects](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=133) [because the behavior change comes from what's in the buffer.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=137)







2:22







[This responsive approach is great during development,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=142) [however, the shader has to account for several possibilities](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=145) [and read from additional buffers](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=149) [which may affect an app's performance.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=151) [Another approach is to specialize the shader](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=154) [at compile time instead of at runtime.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=156) [By building the shader variance offline](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=159) [with preprocessor macros.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=161)







2:45







[This is an uber shader specialized using macros.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=165) [Each specialized shader has its own render pipeline](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=169) [and only has the code it needs](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=172) [for rendering a specific material effect.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=174)







2:58







[This approach means you have to compile all the possible](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=178) [variant combinations offline.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=181) [For example, a glossy variant could be the combination](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=183) [of enabling both is\_glossy and use\_shadows macros,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=187) [by disabling the remaining macros.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=191)







3:14







[Similarly, a matte function variant could be a combination](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=194) [of the use\_shadows and has\_reflections macros.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=198)







3:23







[And a glossy reflections variant enables the is\_glossy](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=203) [and has\_reflections macros and so on.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=206)







3:30







[Implementing an uber shader](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=210) [with macros can mean compiling a large number](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=212) [of variants, such as one variant](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=214) [for each possible macro combination.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=217) [Some of which your app may never use.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=220)







3:44







[Even if you compile them offline ahead of time,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=224) [each variant adds up which can significantly increase](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=227) [the size of your Metal library.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=230) [It can also increase compile time](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=233) [because each shade of variant has to be compiled](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=234) [starting from Metal source.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=237)







4:02







[Function constants can provide another way](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=242) [to specialize the shaders.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=244) [Compared to using macros, it can reduce both compile time](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=245) [and the size of the Metal library.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=249) [With function constants,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=252) [you compile an uber shader one time from source](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=253) [to an intermediate Metal function.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=255) [From that function, you only create the variance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=258) [your app needs based on function constants you define.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=261)







4:27







[Function constants give you the flexibility](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=267) [to both create multiple specialized variants](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=269) [on the go as needed](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=272) [and reuse an intermediate Metal function](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=274) [for all remaining possibilities.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=276)







4:39







[With this approach, you can save time](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=279) [and space by creating only the shader variance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=281) [and render pipelines you need.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=284)







4:47







[You can create these specialized variance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=287) [by declaring function constants in your Metal function code](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=289) [and then defining each of their values](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=293) [as you create Metal functions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=295)







4:58







[You can also use function constants](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=298) [to initialize program scope variables](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=301) [that you declare in the constant address space.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=303)







5:07







[You can enable different code parts in the shader](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=307) [with these function constants instead](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=309) [of reading values from Metal buffers.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=311)







5:15







[With function constants, Metal can fold these](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=315) [as constant Booleans](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=317) [as it compiles the shader's specialization variant,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=319) [as well as other optimizations,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=324) [such as eliminating unreachable code parts.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=325)







5:30







[And that can remove unused control flow.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=330)







5:33







[By specializing shader with function constants,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=333) [you don't need to query material parameters](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=336) [from buffers anymore.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=338) [This approach reduces the shaders runtime](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=340) [by simplifying its control flow](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=342) [and removing unused code parts.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=344) [I encourage you to watch, "Optimize GPU renders with Metal,"](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=348) [which goes over the details on how to set](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=351) [function constant values at runtime.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=353) [It also goes over how to mitigate](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=356) [the runtime compilation overhead](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=358) [with a synchronous compilation.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=359)







6:03







[You can also reduce your shaders runtime](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=363) [by adding the function group's attribute](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=365) [for indirect function calls.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=367)







6:11







[An indirect function is a function the shader calls](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=371) [without directly invoking by its name,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=373) [such as with function pointers or visible function tables.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=376) [A shader can call an indirect function through static](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=382) [or dynamic linking, indirect function calls make the code](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=385) [extensible and give your app more options for flexibility.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=389) [However, indirect function calls can prevent Metal](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=393) [from fully optimizing the shader,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=396) [especially around the call site.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=398)







6:42







[For statically linked functions,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=402) [you can use the Metal function group's feature,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=404) [which lets Metal optimize the shader](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=407) [with indirect function calls.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=409)







6:52







[This shader invokes three different indirect functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=412) [including calls through function pointers for lighting,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=415) [and a material.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=418) [Metal can't optimize across](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=420) [these function pointer call sites](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=422) [because it has no visibility which functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=424) [the shader is calling.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=426) [However, when you know](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=428) [that the function pointers can only point to one](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=429) [of the specific group of functions,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=432) [you can use the function group's attribute.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=434) [For example, the only functions the shader could call](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=437) [are all the linked functions in the shaders pipeline state,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=440) [and you may know that the lighting function can only invoke](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=445) [the area, spot or sphere functions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=448) [In that case, you can group these functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=452) [into your lighting function group.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=454) [Similarly, if the material function pointer can only invoke](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=456) [the wood, glass or metal functions,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=460) [then you can group them into your material function group.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=463) [You can give Metal a hint on how](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=467) [to optimize an indirect call](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=469) [by adding the function group's attribute at the call site.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=471)







7:57







[You define the function groups by assigning a dictionary](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=477) [to a linked functions group's property.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=480) [Each dictionary entry is a string key, which is the name](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=482) [of the function group, and the value is an area of functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=485) [that belong to that group.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=489) [Note that this approach only helps for functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=491) [that you statically link, functions you compile](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=494) [to a binary library will not benefit from this.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=497)







8:22







[Check out these two videos](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=502) [to learn more about the Metal function pointers](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=504) [and the various compilation workflows.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=506)







8:30

10:34

[To summarize, improve resource utilization](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=894) [by choosing the right address space](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=897) [based on the memory usage pattern.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=898) [Choosing 16-bit data types can help reduce the register](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=901) [and memory footprint and in some cases it can result](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=905) [in better utilization of the ALU parallelism](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=908) [in Apple Family 9 GPUs.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=911) [For ray tracing shaders too,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=913) [it is important to reduce shader execution time](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=915) [and improve resource utilization in order](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=918) [to improve the performance.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=920)

17:08

17:21







[Custom intersection functions can enable additional logic](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1041) [to be executed on the shader course.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1044) [Use it only when necessary.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1046) [The opaque triangle intersectors are the fastest path.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1049)

18:14







[Since the custom intersection functions](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1094) [are running in parallel, they will need to be serialized](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1096) [if they perform any operation that has side effects.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1099) [This includes memory writes to the payload](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1103) [or other device memory.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1105) [Similarly, any operations that introduce divergence](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1108) [such as indirect function calls will also reduce](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1112) [the parallelism of the intersection function execution.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1115) [It's best to perform these operations as late as possible](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1119) [in the intersection function](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1122) [to allow maximum parallelism until that point.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1124)

18:57







[This will cause all the code](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1137) [after payload update to be run serially.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1139) [Instead, you can modify the intersection function](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1142) [to have all the work unrelated to the payload update](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1145) [to be done first and then update the payload.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1148) [This will maximize the intersection function parallelism.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1152)

[Returning to the hardware intersector model,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1157) [this flow chart explains the process,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1160) [but it is overlooking one vital element.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1162)







19:26







[During intersection, ray trace scratch space](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1166) [is used to store the state of the traversal](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1169) [and return results to the GPU function calling intersect.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1172)







19:37







[The intersector API supports a payload for each ray.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1177) [The larger the payload structure is](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1181) [the more impact it will have on ray tracing performance.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1183)







19:47







[When it comes to ray payload,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1187) [the intersection result may have most of the data you need](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1189) [and it is best to avoid using any ray payload.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1192) [If you need a payload,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1196) [avoid a global uber payload structure.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1197) [Instead, specialize the structure for each intersect call.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1200)







20:05







[Minimize the size of the structure with packed data types](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1205) [and remove any fields that are not needed.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1209) [Optimizing ray payload usage will result](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1211) [in more rays being processed.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1214) [For example, consider a basic payload](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1217) [with the intersection position,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1219) [a flag to indicate a hit, and a color.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1221) [In memory, the fields would be laid out like this.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1225)







20:31







[The position member would be at the start](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1231) [and due to its size and alignment,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1234) [the hit flag would be 16 bytes from the start,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1236) [but then the RGB member is at a byte offset of 32,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1240) [making an overall struct size of 48 bytes.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1244)







20:49







[By changing the flow three values](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1249) [to their packed equivalence,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1251) [there is less space lost to alignment.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1253) [The hit flag can be removed since it is not needed](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1256) [when using the Metal ray tracing API,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1259) [you can just check the type](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1263) [of intersection in the intersection result.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1264) [This is easy to use and more performant,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1267) [especially for visibility rays like shadows and occlusion.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1269) [Similarly, the position can be computer-based](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1274) [on the ray's origin, direction](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1277) [and the intersection distance from the result.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1279)







21:25







[And then to reduce the size further,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1285) [the RGB color can be packed](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1287) [to four bytes in the intersection function using the packing](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1289) [methods in Metal shading language.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1292)







21:36







[In this example, ray data payload structure started off](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1296) [with the size of 48 bytes and reduced to four bytes.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1299) [By using such methods, you can optimize your array payload](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1304) [to improve the rate tracing performance.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1307)







21:51







[Like ray payload, intersection tags also affect](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1311) [ray tracing performance in a similar way.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1314)







21:58







[Another contributor to ray tracing scratch usage](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1318) [is the intersection tags on the intersector.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1321) [These tags are the additional state](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1324) [for the traversal to track.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1326) [The world space data tag in this declaration means](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1329) [that the object to world](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1333) [and world to object matrices have to be stored for each ray.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1334) [This adds to the retracing scratch usage](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1338) [and will impact occupancy during the intersect call.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1341)







22:27







[The other important thing to note with the tags](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1347) [is that they need to match between the intersector](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1349) [and the intersection functions that it calls.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1352)







22:37







[Intersector is better than intersection query](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1357) [because of how the intersection query API impacts](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1359) [the ray tracing performance.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1362)







22:45







[Looking at the hardware intersector model, it is a great fit](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1365) [for the intersector in the shading language.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1368) [An intersection query defines an object](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1372) [that does not use custom intersection functions.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1374) [The intersection code is executed](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1377) [in the original GPU function](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1379) [and the hardware intersector needs to wait](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1381) [until the code completes before continuing the traversal.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1383)







23:09







[If you choose to use intersection query,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1389) [the hardware has no custom intersection functions to sort](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1391) [and cannot group the execution.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1394) [It also needs to use more ray tracing scratch memory](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1397) [to allow it to return to the GPU function.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1400)







23:24







[Intersection query is the alternative model](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1404) [for ray intersection to support portability](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1407) [from other shading languages.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1409) [Since intersector aligns with the hardware implementation,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1411) [prefer intersector over intersection query.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1415)







23:39







[If you do need to use intersection query,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1419) [use as few query objects as possible.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1421) [If multiple intersection queries are necessary,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1425) [try to reuse the query object, but change the properties.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1427) [This enables reuse of the ray tracing scratch for one query.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1431) [For example, if you have an intersection query object IQ1](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1435) [for doing some ray tracing work,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1439) [and then if you need to do more ray tracing work](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1441) [with the opaque opacity set,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1443) [then instead of creating new intersection query object,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1445) [simply use the intersection params](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1449) [to reset the existing intersection query object](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1451) [with opaque opacity.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1454)







24:17







[This way you can reuse the ray tracing scratch memory.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1457)







24:23







[When using multiple intersection queries,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1463) [avoid switching between them](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1466) [and overlapping their traversal.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1467) [This avoids expensive swaps](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1469) [between the in-progress hardware traversals.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1471)







24:35







[For example, in your ray tracing work,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1475) [instead of switching from IQ1 to IQ2](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1478) [and then back to IQ1.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1480) [Continue with IQ1 and complete the ray tracing work](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1483) [with it before switching to IQ2.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1486) [To summarize ray tracing best practices,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1489) [use custom intersection function only when necessary.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1492) [Optimize ray payload.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1496)







24:59







[Minimize the number of intersection tags.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1499)







25:02







[Use intersector over intersection query.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1502) [To learn more about ray tracing with Metal,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1506) [please watch, "Your guide to Metal ray tracing."](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1509) [And to learn how to use new ray tracing counters](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1512) [from Metal debugger in Xcode,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1514) [check out, "Discover new Metal profiling tools for M3](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1516) [and A17 Pro."](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1520) [To recap, in order to improve performance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1523) [of your Metal shaders, you can reduce shader execution time](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1525) [by using Metal features like function constants](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1529) [and function groups.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1531) [Using such features can enable more optimization](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1533) [opportunities in Metal, improve thread occupancy](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1536) [with better resource utilization to increase parallelism.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1539)







25:44







[Apply the best practices for intersection function,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1544) [ray payload, intersection tags,](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1547) [and the intersector to make the best use](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1549) [of the hardware accelerated ray tracing.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1552) [Thank you very much.](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111373/?time=1555)
